name: Exodus Crash
about: A three-player Vanguard strike on Nessus that fights through Fallen and Vex to Thaviks, the Depraved. In 2026 it comes up as the weekly Grandmaster Vanguard Alert; champions, shields and modifiers change from week to week, so check that week's list.
caveat: Section details come from 2017 to 2021 guides and Destinypedia; the Grandmaster version may add enemies not described here.
sources: Twinfinite: Exodus Crash strike, beating Thaviks
Samurai Gamers: Thaviks the Depraved boss guide
Kyber's Corner: Weekly reset, May 26 2026 (Grandmaster Vanguard Alert)

encounters.name: Prodromus Down
encounters.title: Prodromus Down: track the Fallen
encounters.what: The opening area. Follow the Fallen's Arc Pulses to their camp, break through a barrier, then guard your Ghost while it hacks a Fallen device.
steps: Walk through the glowing Arc Pulses so your Ghost can track the Fallen; there are two rounds of them.
At the end of the trail, kill the Fallen and their captain, Khirin, Blinding Captain, to drop the energy barrier.
Move through the Vex structure to the Exodus Black's aft, where a Fallen device powers another barrier.
Stay near the device while your Ghost analyzes it. Waves attack, and Overcharge Shanks shock and slow anyone close to them.
Two Servitors arrive and jam the hack. Kill both and the analysis carries on; hold the area until it reaches 100 percent.
roles: Stay together near the device, kill Shanks before they get close and focus both Servitors as soon as they appear.
wipes: Standing on the conductive mesh around the device, where the webbing and the Shanks shock you.
Ignoring the Servitors, so the hack stalls while more enemies keep arriving.

encounters.name: Fallen Walker
encounters.title: Glade of Echoes: Fallen Walker
encounters.before: From the device, head across the Exodus Black toward its aft, following another trail of Arc Pulses on the way.
encounters.what: A Fallen Walker and Heavy Shanks guard the way into the ship's aft.
steps: Shoot the Walker's legs until its orange weak point opens, then hit the weak point.
Heavy Pikes on the left side can be taken and used against it; they despawn once the Walker dies.
With the Walker dead, go on into the burning aft.
roles: Focus the legs together, then the weak point, while keeping an eye on the Shanks around it.
wipes: Damage spent on the Walker's armored body instead of its legs and weak point drags the fight out under fire from the Shanks.

encounters.name: Thaviks
encounters.title: Thaviks, the Depraved
encounters.before: Inside the aft (EX-077 Command) it is pitch dark. Fight through the enemies and climb upward to the boss arena.
encounters.what: A cloaking Fallen Marauder, fought on a ring around a central disc joined by four bridges. He vanishes and calls in reinforcements as he loses health.
steps: Clear the Shanks first. Three ring sections have electrical emitters and enemy spawns; Destinypedia calls the left one, seen from the entrance, the safest, with cover and no emitter.
Thaviks starts cloaked and attacks from invisibility with a Shrapnel Launcher. Watch for the shimmer; damaging him makes him visible.
Focus fire while he is visible and keep your distance: his melee hits very hard.

After losing a chunk of health he vanishes in smoke and summons Fallen, including Overcharge Shanks and Servitors, while ring sections electrify. Kill the Shanks first; he comes back once the adds are down.
At about a third of his health he switches to swords and rushes players. Keep moving, keep your distance and use Supers to finish him.
roles: Kill Shanks and Servitors as soon as they spawn so the floor stays safe to stand on.
Track Thaviks through his cloak and burst him whenever he is visible.
wipes: Standing on electrified floor or near Overcharge Shanks, which slow you and drain health.
Falling off the bridges between the ring and the center; the drop is fatal.
Fighting from the middle disc, which Destinypedia calls a deathtrap.
Letting him close in during the sword phase.
